title: Teal Resume Builder: Exciting New Updates & Features!
description:
In this video, we explore the latest updates to the Teal Resume Builder designed to enhance your resume-building experience. Key improvements include an easier navigation between the resume preview and content sections, the ability to add pronouns to your contact information, and a new WYSIWYG (What You See Is What You Get) editor for highlighting keywords and adding links in bullet points. These updates aim to make creating a standout resume simpler and more efficient. Stay tuned for more upcoming features!

00:00 Introduction to Teal Resume Builder Updates
00:06 Improved Navigation Between Resume Sections
01:14 New Pronoun Feature in Contact Info
02:29 WYSIWYG Editor for Bullet Points
03:47 Conclusion and Upcoming Features
